mappingRules.identity: One explicitly labelled AGS/Gemeindeschlüssel/Gemeindekennziffer/Gebietsschlüssel column required. Only that column locates data rows and supplies exact eight-digit source AGS; arbitrary five/eight-digit amounts never identify geography. No zero-padding or name-based join. Five-digit district keys are excluded from town values; absent/ambiguous key columns hold.
mappingRules.evidence: Exact original raw cell lexemes, sheet, coordinates, source hash, source key, schema hash, mapping version; only this column's own header chain and table-title cells support semantics.
mappingRules.dates: Explicit validated native German or ISO reference dates retain their day, including non-year-end debt stocks. Bare native years retain year precision in date and sourceReferenceDate; no invented December 31. Cash requires one explicit numbered quarter and uses a January-through-quarter cumulative period string with period precision, not an invented day. Ambiguous, invalid or conflicting dates hold.
mappingRules.units: Explicit percent, EUR, 1000 EUR, 1000000 EUR and per-inhabitant variants. Preserve Mio./Million(en) EUR as 1000000 EUR and Tausend/Tsd./1 000 EUR as 1000 EUR without changing value. Unsupported Mrd./Milliarden/Billionen/Hundert qualifiers hold instead of matching bare EUR. Own column labels take priority, otherwise only an unambiguous one-cell title supplies units; sibling columns never supply dimensions. Numeric OOXML percent-style tax rates use shared exact-decimal scaling with source style evidence; plain numeric rates never rescale by magnitude. Native date/time-formatted fiscal values hold, never publish Excel calendar serials as money or rates.
mappingRules.scope: Explicit core/special/consolidated labels from this column, otherwise an unambiguous one-cell title. Multiple conflicting scope labels hold the column. Tax series labelled tax_statistics only when no explicit scope exists, never guessed from sibling columns.
mappingRules.suppression: Empty, dot, ellipsis, slash, x and dash excluded, never zero-filled.
mappingRules.financialRole: none: statistics do not assert appropriation, project payment or municipal actual-account document.
mappingRules.taxCapacity: Steuereinnahmekraft maps to statistical_tax_revenue_capacity; Istaufkommen/Steuereinnahmen map to statistical_tax_receipts. Standardized capacity is never relabelled actual collected receipts.
mappingRules.coverage: Parsed supported cells remain partial because live resource completeness has not been established. Unrecognized schema held_quality, captured access wall blocked_access, explicit withdrawal partial without inferred deletion, unknown rights held_origin. Empty native snapshot empty.
